confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Krakow price levels, calibrated against the supplied Madrid, Florence and Lisbon figures; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the more reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are seasonal and least certain. Cocktail and wine glass were set from the local beer price relationship (cocktail a little over twice the beer anchor, wine glass about one and a half times the beer anchor) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Krakow set below the supplied Madrid, Lisbon and Florence benchmarks for restaurant meals and hotel rooms, reflecting Poland's lower general price level, and roughly in line with them for beer, coffee and hostel beds. Basis is general knowledge plus the supplied comparables; no web-sourced city prices were used.
